data.name: RUNNING WITH RIFLES 2
data.detailed_description:
RUNNING WITH RIFLES 2 is a top-down military shooter set in a fictional Eastern Bloc-inspired country seized by the ruthless Vanguard Army. As the occupation tightens its grip, multiple factions emerge in the region, each responding to the conflict in their own way.

Your journey begins as a survivor exploring an open world where scattered survivor communities struggle to endure. They scavenge for supplies, trade resources between their shelters, and build defenses to protect against raiding bandits.

As survivors grow in strength, they begin to fight back against the bandits taking down their camps and hideouts across the region.

Some survivors rise to become the Rebels, operating covertly in cities under the watchful eye of the Vanguard Army. Hidden in plain sight, the Rebels wage a shadow war through sabotage, ambushes, theft of intel, equipment and vehicles, and targeted eliminations of high-ranking officers.

Disguising as regular civilians get them close to restricted areas, but stealth becomes vital once inside the military zones. Use tall grass and foliage for cover, move crouched or prone to reduce noise and visibility, and rely on suppressed weapons or silent takedowns to stay undetected.

Liberator Army stands as the opposing force to the Vanguard Army. Large-scale battles erupt across strategic locations, with waves of infantry supported by armed vehicles, APCs, tanks, and helicopters in relentless clashes for control.

Choose from a wide arsenal of weapons, including assault rifles, shotguns, SMGs, sidearms, light machine guns, sniper rifles, rocket launchers, and hand, smoke, or incendiary grenades. Some battlefields also feature deployable heavy weapons such as mounted machine guns and mortars.

Completing objectives earns experience and promotions, unlocking squad leadership abilities. Recruit up to four squadmates and command them individually or as a unit.

Direct their positioning and field of view, and order them to equip or holster weapons, throw grenades, pick up items, and more. Your squad will follow your commands — but they’ll also react dynamically to the battlefield.

The full campaign can be played solo or cooperatively with friends. A dedicated PvE mode, adapted from the campaign, will also be available on servers offering an experience reminiscent of RWR1's Invasion mode.

  • RWR on launch started with 12 maps à 1km² while RWR2 comes with single world with 25 km² area with no loading screens in between.

  • The campaign has a much larger variety of objectives, and advancing further in the game isn't entirely about capturing zones.

  • Some buildings feature interiors now, and some walls are destructible for entrance, and most walls feature damage effects.

  • Actual health is in play now along with self-healing, allowing player to spend time more surviving and less respawning.

  • Rotating camera control.

  • High grass and foliage help staying unnoticed, there are light sources to stay away from at night time.

  • Bots and commanders have learned plenty of new tricks, e.g. chasing, driving in a convoy, retreating, looting and moving items to storages, and a whole lot of changes in combat to improve on tactics and variety. They handle new types of objectives and communicate their intent to player better. Bot navigation has been rebuilt to better fit the larger and more varied world.

  • Vehicle physics have been reworked, vehicle trunks exist, using one-hand weapons while driving is possible.

  • You can now build actual gapless sandbag wall lines, and bots do it too.

data.short_description: The fan-favorite top-down tactical shooter is back! Bigger, smarter, and more tactical than ever. RWR 2 builds on the acclaimed RUNNING WITH RIFLES with fresh possibilities and familiar charm.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 7. Gen / AMD Ryzen Serie 3000
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 1600 / AMD Radeon 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
